title: scroll clamp height differs from draw_messages visible height
description: page_height() in event.rs computes terminal_size.1.saturating_sub(6).max(1). draw_messages in ui.rs computes area.height.saturating_sub(2) for the inner message panel height. These differ: the layout subtracts borders differently. After a resize, clamp_scroll uses page_height() but draw_messages scrolls by area-derived height, so scroll_offset may be slightly off from the actual visible capacity. Trigger: terminal resize followed by PageUp causes potential blank space at top or clipping of the newest message.
